patthana24.14:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.14:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo na hetudhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.14:3.1: na araṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo na hetudhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. (saṃkhittaṃ.) na saraṇaṃ na sahetukaṃ
